import "date"
import "array"
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Rome")

month_start = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1mo)

pun_value = (from(bucket: "GME")
|> range(start: date.add(d: -1mo, to: month_start))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r._measurement == "gme_monthly_avg" and 
      r._field == "pun_kwh_avg")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

  |> range(start: start)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r._measurement == "realtime" and 
      r._field == "Meter" and 
      r.endpoint == "Import Energy Active" and 
      r.unit == "Wh" and
      exists r._value and r._value > 0.0)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

  "Costo Prelievo Oggi (€)": if prelievo_wh < 0.0

                              else (prelievo_wh / 1000.0) * pun_value
}])

      r.metric == "Production" or r.metric == "Purchased" or
      r.metric == "FeedIn" or r.metric == "Consumption")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: sum, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start", location: location)
  |> group(columns: ["metric"])
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["metric"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      Produzione: r.Production,

  |> range(start: -1h)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gme_monthly_avg" and r._field == "pun_kwh_avg")

import "strings"
import "array"
import "timezone"
import "date"

dec = (x, digits) => {
  p = math.pow(x: 10.0, y: float(v: digits))
  n = int(v: math.round(x: x * p))
  s = if n < 0 then "-" else ""
  a = if n < 0 then -n else n
  ip = a / int(v: p)
  fs = "000000" + string(v: a % int(v: p))
  return s + string(v: ip) + "," + strings.substring(v: fs, start: strings.strlen(v: fs) - digits, end: strings.strlen(v: fs))
}

zona_s = "${zona}"

cei = somma(f: "cei_eur")

ecc = if cei > oe then cei - oe else 0.0

])

    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["endpoint"] == "PRODUCTION_POWER")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

last_record = real_data |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

    int(v: now_time) - int(v: last_record._time) > 1800000000000  // 30 minuti

    true  // Se non ci sono dati, considera produzione finita

    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
